cohort: 5203 singleton pregnancies at a hospital between 2008 and 2015
finding: Fasting plasma glucose levels below those diagnostic of gestational diabetes were associated with large for gestational age (LGA), gestational hypertensive disorders (GHD), and prematurity, while inversely related to small for gestational age (SGA), in a Mediterranean population.
mod_finding: FPG was not significantly related to rate of C-section.
